about.title: Hi, I'm Volkan
about.text: I make games, 3D scenes and odd little web toys. Everything on this page runs right in your browser, so go poke at it.

title: Retro Image
Effects Studio
featured.desc: Scanline, ASCII and pixel-art effects, live.

title: Just Jump It
3D Platformer Game
featured.desc: A Unity 3D jump platformer, exported to WebGL.

projects.title: PS Music Player
projects.subtitle: Pixel-art PlayStation player
projects.desc: A PlayStation-inspired music player in pixel art: spinning disc, visualizer, lyrics and iTunes previews.

projects.title: Windows 98
projects.subtitle: Desktop in a CRT
projects.desc: A working Windows 98 desktop: Paint, Minesweeper, MS-DOS, a media player, Internet Explorer and more.

projects.title: Parking Puzzle
projects.subtitle: Pixel-art puzzle game
projects.desc: Slide the cars and free the red one. 20 levels, par moves and stars to earn.

projects.title: Low-Poly Strike
projects.subtitle: 4v4 shooter in the browser
projects.desc: Free Area against bots, or host a match for friends: Deathmatch and Bomb mode, no server needed. Plays on desktop and phones.

projects.title: Pixel Racer
projects.subtitle: PS1-style arcade racer
projects.desc: Pick a pixel-art car and race bots or friends through Chicago and three classic NFS tracks. Drift, sprint, swap cameras.

projects.title: Fuji Poster
projects.subtitle: Parallax poster scene
projects.desc: A Mt. Fuji print come to life: layers drift as you move, and you can drag the car around.

built.title: BMW M3 GTR
built.text: Modelled scene set up in Godot, lit and exported to the web as a WebAssembly build. The biggest challenge was keeping a 70 MB scene loadable in a browser.

built.title: Just Jump It
built.text: A 3D platformer built in Unity with C# player controls, exported with Unity's WebGL template and compressed for the web.

built.title: Retro Image FX
built.text: Reads every pixel of an uploaded image with the Canvas API: scanlines blank out rows, ASCII maps brightness to characters, and pixel art averages blocks then snaps them to a small palette.

built.title: PS Music Player
built.text: PlayStation artwork layered in canvases and pixelated live with an ordered dither. Web Audio drives the visualizer; iTunes and lyrics come from public APIs.

built.title: Windows 98
built.text: A tiny window manager in plain JavaScript: draggable, resizable windows, a taskbar and Start menu, plus Paint, Minesweeper, an MS-DOS prompt and a media player. Every icon is drawn from code.

built.title: Parking Puzzle
built.text: Sliding-block puzzle with drag, tap and keyboard controls. A Python solver checks every level, works out its par, and hill-climbs new harder levels.

built.title: Low-Poly Strike
built.text: A 4v4 shooter in plain JavaScript. One tab hosts the match and the others connect peer to peer, by room code or copy-paste. The same rules run offline against bots.

lab.title: Widget Desktop
lab.desc: A desktop of 25 draggable, resizable widgets over a photo you wipe clear with a lens: weather, Snake, calculator, habits, ambient sounds and more. On phones it turns into an Android-style home screen.

lab.title: Glass Cursor
lab.desc: A canvas trail toy: 6 shapes, 6 palettes, spring and orbit motion, kaleidoscope mirror, paint mode, multi-touch and PNG export.
